notes.title: Merch Pre-orders and My Next Project
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40280611/81f43af4a230f6aeb166d30a293bec7aa0fa5425.png[/img]

Heyo! Moon Observatory Iris' commemorative merch set and final art book printing pre-orders are open until Oct 17! Thanks to all the people who took the time to read my work.

[url=https://batensan.bigcartel.com/]Online store here![/url]

If you enjoyed MOI, please keep an eye out on social media for my [url=https://twitter.com/MoonObservatory]next project [i]The Doll Witch[/i], which will be a light novel/audiobook![/url] It'll be 100% free to read, and I'm excited to share it sometime next year!

Thanks again!
Baten

notes.title: Auggie Route and Auggie Plush Interest Check!
notes.notes:
Hey! I think I forgot to mention that earlier this year, a major update came to the game with Auggie's route and partial voice acting added!

I hope you enjoy that! It will most likely be the last content update to MO Iris.

---

In other news, the Auggie cube plush sample is finished! If you're interested in having one, please fill out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSBSfkGp9UPsx33lHYxPXjGwsEnDPejc6sLLOcxAHEJ2QWEA/viewform]this interest check form![/url]

Since this is very niche, production may not happen if there is a lack of interest 🥺🙏
Even so, please answer honestly in the form!

Hopefully the plush will be able to debut with other MO Iris commemoration merch later this year as sort of a goodbye to the game and cast.

Thank you so much for supporting my work!
